title: Emission factor set
description: A versioned, citable collection of emission factors from ONE publisher and ONE publication year.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, or 'GLOBAL'. Applying a regional factor outside its region is the single most common inventory error.

id.description: Globally unique, stable across releases. Never reuse an id with a changed value — publish a new id instead.

scope3Category.description: GHG Protocol Scope 3 Standard category number.

scope2Method.description: Required for Scope 2. The GHG Protocol Scope 2 Guidance mandates dual reporting; a factor is only valid for one method.

unit.description: Denominator unit of the activity data. Must match a member of the Unit enum.

basis.description: GCV (higher heating value) vs NCV (lower heating value). Mixing bases misstates fuel emissions by roughly 5-10%.

components.description: Mass of each gas emitted per one activity unit, in kilograms. Kept per-gas (not pre-aggregated to CO2e) so the GWP set stays a caller choice.

componentsAreDerived.description: True when the per-gas split was reconstructed rather than published as gas masses. Most publishers report the split already multiplied by their own GWPs, so recovering the masses means dividing those back out.

publishedCo2eKgPerUnit.description: The CO2e figure the publisher printed, per activity unit. Kept so a caller can reproduce the publisher's own total exactly. Required when no gas breakdown exists at all, which is the normal case for well-to-tank and other value-chain factors.

publishedGwpBasis.description: The assessment report the publisher aggregated publishedCo2eKgPerUnit under. Without it the figure cannot be placed in an inventory, because CO2e is meaningless until you know which GWP set produced it.

region.description: Overrides the set's region for this factor. Needed whenever one published dataset covers several jurisdictions or grid areas, which is the normal case for electricity.

sourceReference.description: The publisher's own identifier for this row, so a reader can find it in the original file.

biogenicCarbonKg.description: Biogenic CO2 per activity unit. Reported separately from the scope totals under the GHG Protocol, never added into them.

uncertaintyPercent.description: Relative standard uncertainty (%) as published, for ISO 14064-1 uncertainty assessment.
